hercule.name: La tente de l'Hercule
hercule.alt: The main ring of the strongman's tent under a patched red and yellow-orange striped big top, painted in ink and gouache: one low sawdust ring round a central pole, packed with performers. Ryan swings on the trapeze ropes high above with his top hat flying, the old roof is patched with dozens of bright squares, and a mobile of dumbbells dangles from the pole. In the ring a strongman in a green cap lifts a cow over his head, another stands motionless beside the dangling dumbbells, a strongwoman in red carries a table top under one arm, a little knight raises a feather duster, and a brass band plays a slow funeral march on tuba and trombone. A bull stands steady on a platform while a crate beside it tips over. At the front a strongman lounges on a table of cushions, Nan peers over her glasses at a mouse lifting dumbbells and forgets her knitting, a strongman taps a black lead weight, a helmeted traveler slumps and yawns, and a lion hides behind his paw by a barrel. Below the ring a mole drives a tiny train through a tunnel. Curtained archways with a dove on the left and a boxing glove and a medal on the right lead to side rooms, four little balcony doors open above, and a curtain bottom left opens onto the park path.

calme.name: Le coin calme
calme.alt: A quiet, lantern-lit corner of the strongman's tent, painted in ink and gouache, under red and cream striped canvas on a straw floor. At the back a very tall strongman hoists a whole rack of dumbbells overhead, an old bell hangs quietly in a little wooden bell tower, and a small striped ticket booth glows with a window showing a stag, a strongman with apples, an old couple at tea and a laughing lion. Two children sniffle at a puppy movie on a little screen, a cat in a deli apron tiptoes past a row of eggs, a strongman pulls a face at his lukewarm mug of tea with a soggy teabag flopped on his head, a peaceful lion naps with a butterfly on his nose, and a blue jay lands on the top hat of an embarrassed man giving a speech on a crate. In front, a strongman keeps up a drumbeat on a big drum with two dumbbells, another gently shields a baby turtle in his cupped hands, a white swan in a round paddling pool bows to a duckling, and two strong hands clasp in a firm handshake over a wooden block. A red-curtained doorway on the left leads back to the main ring, with crates, a coiled rope and a lantern on the right.

doors.label: La tente de l'Hercule
doors.hint: Go back through the curtained doorway to the main ring

calme_guichet.name: Le guichet
calme_guichet.alt: Close-up through the striped ticket-booth window in the quiet corner, painted in ink and gouache: a cozy little lantern-lit room. A majestic stag stands proud with a red robin perched on one antler, Dan the strongman staggers under an overflowing crate of apples that tumble to the floor, an old married couple share one small breakfast table with two cups and a teapot, a digital scoreboard on the wall shows red bars climbing higher and higher, and a strongman giggles so hard that the lion beside him roars with laughter too.

arene.name: L'arène
arene.alt: The strongman arena, a sawdust ring under red and yellow-orange striped canvas, painted in ink and gouache. A fiddler saws so hard his strings snap, a kettle shrieks and blows its lid off as a strongman leaps in fright, and a grumpy wind cloud puffs the crew's tent pegs away while they chase them. Two tense strongmen arm-wrestle at a table, a strict referee in stripes holds up a long ruler, and a tall brute grips an iron bar. In front, a strongman swoons onto a teak bench still holding a feather with a gray cat beside him, an angry goose honks at the strongmen, a little ginger kitten roars from a stool, and a strongman squeezes a jam jar so hard that purple grape jam bursts everywhere. A small striped ticket booth glows at the back, a red-curtained archway on the left leads back to the main ring, and a punching bag and a rack of dumbbells stand on the right behind a rope barrier.

doors.label: La tente de l'Hercule
doors.hint: Go back through the curtained doorway to the main ring

zooms.label: le guichet
zooms.hint: Look closer at the ticket booth

arene_guichet.name: Le guichet
arene_guichet.alt: A close look through the striped ticket booth window in the strongman arena, between red velvet curtains. A grinning hippo sits right on top of a strongman in a striped tank top who flashes a forced grin, a tiny red horned imp the size of a mouse sits on a heap of straw clutching a little toy sword, a secret agent in a trench coat peers through a magnifying glass at an egg, and an imposing bearded strongman strikes such a big pose that he shoves the tent pole aside. Through the back window a menacing storm cloud glowers over a little striped tent.

podium.name: Le podium
podium.alt: The winners' podium corner of the strongman tent under red and yellow-orange striped canvas with patches and strings of little lights, painted in ink and gouache. High above, an acrobat walks the rope over a big fat safety net, and a terrifying shadow looms on the tent wall with a feather duster in its hand. A strongman lifts a whole wardrobe, a tiny green pea heaves two weights under a smiling painted sun, a little mouse in a crown stands proud on the winners' box, and a strongman holds a grand piano overhead with a cat sitting on top. The ringmaster cheers a tiny mouse carrying a whole wheel of cheese, a strongman lifts a bar loaded right up with extra weights, a team of four strongmen loses a tug-of-war to one tiny mouse, and a monstrous jack-o'-lantern pumpkin is wheeled in on a cart. A small striped ticket booth glows at the back, a wooden archway on the left looks back into the busy main ring, and a giant trophy, a gong and a rolled red carpet stand on the right.

doors.label: La tente de l'Hercule
doors.hint: Go back through the archway to the main ring

zooms.label: le guichet
zooms.hint: Look closer at the ticket booth

podium_guichet.name: Le guichet
podium_guichet.alt: A close look through the striped ticket booth window on the winners' podium, between red velvet curtains. Ann the strongwoman in a striped leotard proudly holds up a tiny green pea in front of a huge boulder, a bearded strongman balances a teacup on his hand, and a round porthole shows a golden sunset over the sea with a seagull hovering to stare. Cal the strongman lifts a little striped tent overhead with the spectators still inside, a brave mouse heaves a dumbbell off a trapped beetle, and a dominant gorilla guards a tall stack of dominoes.

gradins.name: Les gradins
gradins.alt: The busy walkway at the foot of the spectator stands in the strongman tent, under red and yellow-orange striped canvas, painted in ink and gouache, with the crowd on the wooden benches behind. A vigilant meerkat stands up behind a bald strongman's head scanning the crowd, a lamp post glows half red and half green, a knight bows so low his helmet clangs on the floor, and a smiling strongman hands a lost wallet back to a lady. A frappe milkshake in a bright neon glass stands on a little table, a rabbit perched on a big drum thumps it with his foot, one strongman puffs up a balloon as big as a globe, and another stands firm with his arms folded, hair blown back by a big fan. A rigorous referee crouches with a ruler and a magnifying glass over a barbell, a tiny ant lifts a whole sandwich over her head on a crate, Max goes red in the face lifting a heavy barbell, a stubborn pony digs in her hooves while her handler pulls, and a hamster runs on his wheel. A red-curtained doorway with steps on the left leads back down to the main ring; a popcorn cart and a lantern stand on the right.

doors.label: La tente de l'Hercule
doors.hint: Go back down through the curtained door to the main ring

agres.name: Les agrès
agres.alt: The apparatus loft of the strongman tent, a wooden training floor under red and yellow-orange striped canvas with ropes and rings, painted in ink and gouache, with a painted tree and a tall mountain backdrop. A leaf tumbles down from the painted tree, a goat hops from rock to rock on the mountainside prop, a polar bear peeks out of her icy den, and a fairy kneels beside a pony holding an iron horseshoe. A robot with one metal arm lifts a wooden pole, a strongman's frizzy curls hold two nesting kittens, another strongman balances a wobbly chair on his head with a kitten on top, and a beaver proudly shows a drawing of his dam. In front, a blank wooden plaque stands on an easel, a squirrel leaps over a barbell, a little mouse lifts two peas on a stick, a hamster heaves a bowling ball, a strongman lies stiff as a plank across two chairs while a pony stands on him, and a pot of water stands on a table. A red-curtained doorway at the top of a stair on the left leads back down to the main ring; a pommel horse and coiled ropes stand on the right.

doors.label: La tente de l'Hercule
doors.hint: Go back down through the curtained door to the main ring

coulisses.name: Les coulisses
coulisses.alt: The cluttered backstage of the strongman tent, red and yellow-orange striped canvas walls, a costume rack and old trunks, painted in ink and gouache. Two blank wooden plaques hang on the canvas, a soap bubble shaped like a little horse floats by, and a small window shows a black thunderstorm crackling with lightning over a little striped tent. A canary flies free while a clown sits stuck in the birdcage, a rusty robot strongman stands still, and a goat munches a big hole in a red curtain. A mouse crosses a tightrope above two sleeping cats, and a bubbling green potion stands beside a drooping pot plant. In front, a young activist holds up a blank sign and hands out leaflets, one monkey sticks out his tongue, another waves a banana to tease, a pom-pom poodle struts nose high, and a rat recoils from a smelly heap of old socks. A red-curtained doorway with steps on the left leads back down to the main ring; a mirror and leopard-print costumes stand on the right.

doors.label: La tente de l'Hercule
doors.hint: Go back down through the curtained door to the main ring

grenier.name: Le grenier
grenier.alt: The cozy attic under the peak of the strongman tent, sloping red and yellow-orange striped canvas over a plank floor, painted in ink and gouache. A blank wooden plaque hangs on the wall, a round window shows the moon growing from a thin crescent to full, a friendly ghost aunty floats past a toy haunted house with a tray of cookies, and a man sneezes so hard that a little tent blows away. A barbell floats up tied to a bunch of balloons, a kind judge points a muddy puppy to a bath tub, a walrus scowls at his tiny trophy, and a tired peasant flops onto a haystack. A glowering bull stands by a giant frozen yogurt cup while a tiny bug scurries off, a cricketer swings his bat, a gentle bull sings while two hens weep, a puppy shreds a cushion into a snowstorm of feathers, a strongman lifts a little elephant while mice leap up cheering, and a girl waves goodbye from a little train car as puppies cry. A narrow stair behind red curtains on the left leads back down to the main ring; old trunks, a rolled rug and a stone strongman statue stand on the right.

doors.label: La tente de l'Hercule
doors.hint: Go back down through the curtained door to the main ring
